rule: Keep a term only if (a) the owner introduced it, (b) it is a plain English description of what it does, or (c) it is the standard PoE1/PoE2 term used in the same meaning. Everything else is purged (renamed plainly, or removed with its mechanic if that mechanic was invented and does nothing). 'Spirit' and 'blood' were named by the owner as made up (2026-11-08).

owner.brand: owner: 'brands are added through explicit enchantments and crafts' (ledger)
owner.bond: owner: 'bonds are gradually gained by using the item' (ledger)
owner.crafting: owner: 'crafting should be more like PoE' (ledger)
owner.refund: owner: 'Refund points should only be needed to refund the passive skill nodes' (ledger)
owner.lattice: owner: 'my skill tree and spell lattice idea'
owner.weave: owner: 'dex and str need their own ways to weave power'

spirit.note: Decided 2026-11-08. Names the resource every action spends (verdigris-stats.js label Spirit; tree-data "+12 to Spirit"); PoE2 Spirit is a reservation budget, so fails (c).
